desc_en: This two-piece set pairs a short-sleeve t-shirt with a midi skirt. Crafted from lightweight polyester, it offers a relaxed and fluid silhouette. The solid color design ensures versatility for various occasions. A practical approach to everyday wear that prioritizes comfort without sacrificing understated elegance. Each piece is made to order to guarantee absolute exclusivity. Available with worldwide shipping.

Cada pieza se confecciona bajo pedido para garantizar la máxima exclusividad. Disponible con envío a todo el mundo.
